name: upnext
description: Up next: a Claude Code plugin that consolidates your active plan with suggested next steps—ranking the current frontier above the prompt, in a Plan pane (p), or across background agents, with completed history, session handoff, PR summaries, and GitHub Issues sync.

clickAction.title: What a click on a step does
clickAction.description: draft: put the step's prompt in the prompt box for you to edit and send. send: send it right away (⎘ then drafts).

extractor.title: How to find next steps
extractor.description: auto: read each reply's headings, lists and offers; when a reply has none, ask a fork of the session (about one short reply) to find implicit steps or guess what you'll ask next, and check whether steps you ran got done. heuristic: the reader alone, never a model call. model: always ask the fork.

rank.title: How to pick the most important steps
rank.description: auto: score open steps for free every turn (failed before, failing tests, what you asked for, wording, recency), and when new steps arrive with four or more open, have Haiku re-rank them from a short brief (no copy of the conversation). p re-ranks on demand. local: the free score only. off: no ranked section, the plain list.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest reply to ask the model about
minAnswerChars.description: Replies shorter than this are read without a model call.

nudgeAfter.title: Nudge about idle streams after this many turns
nudgeAfter.description: When a stream with open steps has had no new or finished steps for this many turns, a toast says so once, so you can pick it up or archive it. 0 turns this off.

clearDoneAfter.title: Clear done steps after this many turns
clearDoneAfter.description: A step that gets done (✓), by a turn, a commit, a passing test or a click, leaves the pane this many turns later. 0 clears it at the end of the turn that did it, with a toast. A negative number keeps done steps until you clear them.

fadeAfter.title: Fade untouched steps after this many turns
fadeAfter.description: A step nobody has run, edited, moved or suggested again for this many turns is drawn dim and ranks lower. 0 turns fading off.

oldAfter.title: Move untouched steps to "older" after this many turns
oldAfter.description: Past this many untouched turns a step moves into a folded "older" group at the bottom, where you can restore it. Nothing is deleted. 0 keeps every step in the tree.

autoTick.title: Tick steps off from commits and passing tests
autoTick.description: After a git commit, marks open steps its message clearly covers as done; after a test run that passes, marks steps like "fix the failing test" or "run the tests" as done. A toast says what was ticked.

band.title: Show the top steps above the prompt
band.description: The top three steps, above the prompt box: press 1, 2 or 3 from an empty prompt box to act on one (a prompt is drafted, a check is ticked, a decision starts your answer), 0 to hide them until the next turn.

bandStyle.title: How the top steps show above the prompt
bandStyle.description: list: three lines, the top three steps, each with why and its stream. row: one line with the three steps side by side.

ghostText.title: Offer the top step as ghost text
ghostText.description: Shows the top new step as dim text in the prompt box; Tab takes it as a draft.

statusLine.title: Count open steps in the status line
statusLine.description: Shows "✦ 3 next steps" in the status line while steps are open.

keepAcrossSessions.title: Keep a session's steps for when it is resumed
keepAcrossSessions.description: Saves each session's open steps and brings them back, folded, when you resume that session. A new session always starts with an empty list.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when new steps arrive
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane beside the transcript when steps arrive, unless you closed it. Off by default: the three lines above the prompt show the top steps, and /upnext opens the pane.

paneStyle.title: Where the tree is drawn inside herdr
paneStyle.description: auto: inside herdr, the tree opens as a popup over Claude's pane on a key (prefix+u with the herdr plugin linked, or /upnext herdr), and herdr's sidebar shows the top step. split: a herdr pane beside Claude's that stays open. claude: always the pane inside Claude. Outside herdr every setting uses the pane inside Claude.

herdrLabel.title: Show Up next in herdr's sidebar and pane title
herdrLabel.description: Inside herdr, sets the `upnext` pane token ("3 next · Auth: Rotate the key") for a sidebar row, and the title of Claude's pane to "3 next".

herdrGlyphs.title: Symbols in the herdr pane
herdrGlyphs.description: symbols: ○ ✓ ✗ ▶ ✕ and tree lines, all ones herdr draws one cell wide. ascii: plain characters, if your font draws a symbol badly.

scanToolOutput.title: Read todo and task lists too
scanToolOutput.description: Adds open todo/task items from TodoWrite and TaskCreate/TaskUpdate.
